TrackingSetup.title: How to enable tracking
TrackingSetup.subtitle: Add the Searchable tracker to your site so AI crawler visits show up in your dashboard.
TrackingSetup.step1: Add a site below to create a Tracking ID for your domain.
TrackingSetup.step2: Copy the Tracking ID from the Sites table.
TrackingSetup.step3: Paste the script snippet into your site’s HTML just before the closing </body> tag, replacing YOUR_TRACKING_ID with your Tracking ID.
TrackingSetup.step4: Deploy your site. When AI crawlers visit, activity will appear on that site’s Activity page.
TrackingSetup.snippetHint: Host tracker.js where your site can load it, and keep data-site-id set to your Tracking ID.
